property_summary: For every caller who is not the owner, calling sendMoney(target, value, data) must not succeed in transferring contract balance (i.e., the call should revert or fail for non-owners); the mutant removing the onlyOwner check allows a non-owner helper to successfully make the contract send funds out for some fuzzed target/amount, violating this rule.
change_summary: Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the require check, so sendMoney becomes callable by non-owners and can change observable behavior.
